text:
maria-ops: Heads up @kai-finance — Nora Corp invoice INV-7890 (due 2025-03-20) keeps failing. 3x card declines (last try 03/22 14:12 UTC). They tried ACH via Plaid but microdeposits didn't match. They want to wire if we can provide instructions and waive late fee. Need next steps.

kai-finance: Do we still have a tokenized card on file and how many automatic retries ran?

maria-ops: Card is tokenized. System did 3 automatic retries per policy (max_retries=3). Stripe bot shows retries exhausted. We paused further automated retries.

stripe-bot: Payment retry attempts exhausted for customer:nora-corp (INV-7890). No further automatic retries scheduled.

ben-cs: I'm on a call with their billing contact now. They got an "account type mismatch" when linking ACH (Plaid). They're willing to initiate an outgoing wire today if we send wire instructions and waive the late fee if sent within 48h.
kai-finance: Finance is OK to approve a one-time late-fee waiver conditional on legal sign-off and receipt of wire. Also OK to authorize one manual CC attempt if we get explicit signed authorization from their billing contact.
eve-legal: Legal OK in principle. Requirements: (1) signed PO or explicit authorization email from a recognized billing contact, (2) copy of wire receipt after transfer, (3) standard AML/KYC checks clear. We can't bypass KYC.

maria-ops: Good. I'll pause retries (done) and ask CS to collect PO and the billing contact email for authorization. Ben, can you paste the wire details they provided (redact sensitive parts if needed)?

ben-cs: They sent this (redacted):
```
Wire instructions
Bank: First Example Bank
Beneficiary: Nora Consulting LLC
Account: 000123456789 (last 4 = 6789)
Routing: 111000025
SWIFT: FEBEUS33
Reference: INV-7890
```

ben-cs: They also asked we attempt 1 manual CC charge after they email authorization (they think card may now work).
kai-finance: Manual CC attempt OK but only 1, and only after we have a timestamped authorization email from the billing contact that explicitly allows charge of invoice INV-7890 for $X. We'll need to cc finance on that email for audit.

maria-ops: Action plan: 1) Ben to get PO + authorization email (Ben). 2) Maria paused automated retries (complete). 3) Kai to prepare a manual-charge approval template and checklist (Kai). 4) Eve to stand by for quick legal sign-off once PO/authorization arrive. I'll set a 48h SLA for resolution and update thread. :thumbsup:

ben-cs: Sending PO and billing contact email now (cc @kai-finance). Customer confirmed on call they'll include INV-7890 in wire reference for reconciliation.
kai-finance: Received the email. Preparing the approval template now. Template will include: required fields, amount, timestamp, billing contact, and statement authorizing manual charge.
eve-legal: I have the PO. Quick review underway. If PO and billing contact match our records, I can sign off within the hour. If KYC flags appear, I'll escalate.

maria-ops: Once legal signs off: option A = perform one manual CC attempt and record attempt with authorization; option B = accept wire, mark invoice PAID on receipt of cleared funds + upload wire receipt. Kai, if manual CC fails, we should revert to wire.
kai-finance: Agreed. If manual charge succeeds, record payment method = CARD (manual) and keep original event log. If they wire, update ledger with method = WIRE and attach receipt; waive late fee per approval.

stripe-bot: Manual payment attempts allowed only after explicit customer authorization recorded.

ben-cs: Customer just confirmed they'll initiate wire if legal approves waiver. Sending them the redacted wire instructions and asked them to attach receipt when done.
maria-ops: Received confirmation from CS. Setting ticket priority = high and SLA = 48h. Will close thread after payment posts.
kai-finance: Remember to include note about not exceeding one manual CC attempt to minimize dispute risk. Also log the waiver approval in the invoice notes.
eve-legal: Waiver signed off. Condition: must receive PO + copy of wire receipt for records. If wire does not arrive in 48h, we'll resume standard collection workflows.

ben-cs: Forwarding to customer: PO accepted, waiver approved. They'll initiate wire within 48h and send receipt.
maria-ops: Thanks team. I'll update ticket and mark next steps. Closing loop when we have proof of payment. :bank:
